name: Ardour
tagline: An open source, collaborative effort of a worldwide team including musicians, programmers, and professional recording engineers.
description: Ardour is an open source, collaborative effort of a worldwide team including musicians, programmers, and professional recording engineers.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/ardour:version-2026-06-19@sha256:720a44efc9e158e56fd1f12e00f190746f73bcf1fa20aa508c8e9c59f27dc423
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
